Scope

This licence covers Outfit Manager's own work: OutfitManager.asi and the mod's
own files (stylesheet merges, texture list merges, and the textures it creates).

It does not cover Crimson Desert's own content, which belongs to Pearl Abyss:
the three files in files/0012/ui/bin__/ are the game's gear-wheel UI files with
Outfit Manager's tab added, and some textures are derived from the game's art.

Third-party code: OutfitManager.asi contains MinHook by Tsuda Kageyu (and the
Hacker Disassembler Engine it includes), under their own BSD licences; see
THIRD-PARTY-MinHook-LICENSE.txt.
